title: 第1070章 合适人选第1069章 铁家风波
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: “大小姐还等着什么？
不过是一个人罢了。而且她也能因为此事和我铁家攀附上关系，对她又何尝不是一件好事？
甚至若对方日后能在这大罗之境之内突破的更深层次，或许未来家主大人也未必不能够圆了大小姐的心思，让你们二人喜结连理。
这种事情，向来也没什么不太可能的。”
此话徐徐一出，铁秋雨顺着那如水的月光继续朝自家大小姐望去。
此刻才猛然发觉，大小姐的身影却是早早的消失不见了。
去的还真是够快的说。
只能够说这女子一旦为了自身的情郎，那有的时候可真是飞蛾扑火，不顾一切的。
实在是令人心头一紧。
铁秋雨只是坐落在这高处的屋檐之上，不知为何他的心头却是猛的一揪，感觉不是特别的舒服。
“父亲。我有一个合适的人选。”
铁珊瑚冲到了铁正义的身前，来到了书房，将此事直接娓娓道来：“此人不过只是下界飞升之人，所以对于我铁家不会有威胁的。
而且也能让赔付上官家的代价少上一些。
接下来可就是百年一次我青茅山的冬灾之时。
若是族内佛辈好完备的相关资源，接下来那可是会出事的。
女儿不想父亲在这族中继续受什么太多的非议了，女儿也想为族中多做一些事情才对。”
铁珊瑚徐徐开口，将此话一一说出。
铁正义耐人寻味的看了这个女儿一眼，紧接着并未打消女儿来意。
在她的帮助之下，必然是能够突破到大罗玄仙之境的。
而至于大罗玄仙之境之上的道路，即便铁正义再对铁珊瑚还有魔道老祖的传承有如何的自信心，也不敢有太多的奢望。
只要能突破便就是好事一桩。
而突破完了，那便是对于铁家的大力发展。
如此的境况之下，自然显然该为了整个铁家开枝散叶的。
而对于一位名副其实的大罗玄仙之境而言，任何上不得台面的手段都不可能对铁家有半分的伤害。
所以这个时候自家女儿的个人感受，因此也便就成了一件极其重要的事情。
最重要的还是铁家未来有期，所以女儿的重要性便也一下子就高了许多。
“可以尝试一下。
你先将此子唤来我青茅山铁家寨。
届时见此子人品、心性、修为、实力，若是当真无碍，我会带着他前去那上官家的。
届时一切便也就安然无恙最好不过。”
铁正义寥寥数语，便已是应下了女儿的这份请求。
铁珊瑚面露大喜。
不过很显然，以她现如今获得了大罗玄仙之境传承的身份，是绝不可能贸贸然的离开铁家寨的。
所以此事便只能交给铁秋雨。
铁秋雨轻叹了一声：“大小姐，奴婢可真是个劳碌命。”
画面一转，再回到这天机主城之内。
铁秋雨有着和楚风此前的那一场经历，找到他还是比较轻松的。
更何况大罗之境的实力可不是现如今太古仙道之内除了楚风之外其他人能够拦得住的。
所以一路而来，自然是顺利得紧。
“你小子现如今可是有好福气了。

;;
"What are you waiting for, Miss?
It's just a person. And she can also get involved with my Tie family because of this matter, so isn't it a good thing for her?
Even if the other party can break through to a deeper level within the realm of Da Luo in the future, maybe the future head of the family may not be able to fulfill the eldest lady's wish and let you two get married.
This kind of thing has never been impossible. "
As soon as these words came out slowly, Tie Qiuyu continued to look at his eldest lady along the watery moonlight.
At this moment, I suddenly realized that the figure of the eldest lady had disappeared early.
It went really fast.
It can only be said that once this woman is for her lover, sometimes she will really fly into the flames and be desperate.
It's really heart-wrenching.
Tie Qiuyu was just sitting on the eaves of this high place. For some reason, his heart suddenly tightened and he didn't feel particularly comfortable.
"Father. I have the right man."
Tie Hualou rushed to Tie Zhengyi, came to the study, and spoke directly about the matter: "This person is just a person who ascended from the lower world, so he will not be a threat to my Tie family.
And it can also reduce the price of compensation to the Shangguan family.
The next step will be a once-in-a-hundred-year winter disaster in Qingmao Mountain.
If the Buddhas in the clan had complete relevant resources, something would happen next.
The daughter doesn't want her father to continue to suffer too much criticism in the clan, and the daughter also wants to do more things for the clan. "
Tie Coral slowly opened his mouth and said these words one by one.
Tie Zhengyi glanced at his daughter intriguingly, but then did not give up on his daughter's intention to come.
With her help, he will definitely be able to break through to the realm of Daluo Xuanxian.
As for the road above the realm of Daluo Xuanxian, no matter how confident Tie Zhengyi was in Tie Coral and the inheritance of the demon ancestor, he did not dare to have too many extravagant hopes.
As long as there is a breakthrough, it is a good thing.
And once the breakthrough is completed, it will be a great development for the Tie family.
Under such a situation, it was obviously time to branch out for the sake of the entire Tie family.
For a person who is worthy of the name of Da Luo Xuanxian, any unscrupulous means cannot cause any harm to the Tie family.
So at this time, my daughter's personal feelings have become an extremely important matter.
The most important thing is that the Tie family has a bright future, so the importance of the daughter suddenly becomes much higher.
“You can try it.
You first call this son to my Qingmao Mountain Tiejiazhai.
When I see this son's character, temperament, cultivation, and strength, if he is really fine, I will take him to Shangguan's house.
It would be best if everything was fine by then. "
Tie Zhengyi agreed to his daughter's request with just a few words.
Iron Coral looked overjoyed.
However, it was obvious that with her current status of inheriting the realm of Daluo Xuanxian, she would never leave Tiejiazhai rashly.
Therefore, this matter can only be left to Tie Qiuyu.
Tie Qiuyu sighed softly: "Miss, being a slave is such a hard life."
The scene turned and returned to the main city of Tianji.
Tie Qiuyu had the previous experience with Chu Feng, so it was relatively easy to find him.
What's more, the strength of Daluo Realm is not something that anyone else in the Taikoo Immortal Dao can stop now except Chu Feng.
So the journey along the way was naturally smooth.
"You boy are very lucky now.
